newsitem.title: USA: MAVESA SA NAMES ALBERTO PHELPS CEO.
newsitem.headline: MAVESA SA NAMES ALBERTO PHELPS CEO.

text.p: Mavesa SA said today that it has named Alberto Tovar Phelps as chief executive, effective September 1.
He succeeds Juan Fernando Roche, who has been hired by Nabisco International to become president of Nabisco Iberia and Regional Director for Europe, Middle East and Africa.

Phelps has been with the company 14 years and is currently vice-chairman of Mavesa's board of directors. He assumed the chief executive's duties in 1995-1996 while Roche completed a fellowship at Harvard University.
Mavesa is a manufacturer, marketer and distributor of consumer goods based in Venezuela.
